dialogs.text:
Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 and Z Fold8 Series Trade-in Offer

Trade-In Offer Details

Eligibility: New and existing customers activating a new line or upgrading an existing line. 
Discounts:  
Up to $1,200 off Galaxy Z Flip8, Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra with activation on AT&T Premium 2.0 plan or higher (starting at $100/mo. plus taxes and fees, before discounts for single line) or select retired/legacy unlimited plans and trade-in of an eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $95 or more (up to $1,000 off with trade-in value of $35-$94).
Up to $1,000 off eligible devices with activation on AT&T Extra 2.0 plan (starting at $80/mo. plus taxes and fees, before discounts for single line) and trade-in of an eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $95 (up to $800 off with trade-in value of $35-$94). Customers on legacy Starter/Starter SL plans qualify for a max of $800 off eligible devices with trade-in of eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $35 or more.
Up to $500 off eligible devices with activation on AT&T Value 2.0 plan (starting at $60/mo. plus taxes and fees, before discounts for single line) and trade-in of eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $35 or more.
Purchase Requirements: Requires qualifying 0% APR 36-month installment plan with monthly payments of up to $75; based on eligible device purchased. $0 down is available for well-qualified customers; others may require a down payment. Other installment options may vary by account type. Customers must pay tax on full retail price and an activation/upgrade fee of $35 per line. 
Credits: Credits applied over installment term, starting within 3 bills. If the wireless plan on the purchased device is lowered during the installment term, credits may stop or be reduced to the max avail. for the lower plan, if eligible. Canceling wireless service stops credits and remaining device balance is due. If adding a new line, must not cancel service on any other line within 90 days or credits may stop. Early payoff or upgrade may stop credits. Max credit will not exceed device cost or eligible credit amt.
Plan Limitations/Restrictions: This offer requires an eligible postpaid unlimited voice & data plan. AT&T may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy.  AT&T 55+, Value Plus, Value Plus VL, and Value Plus Unlimited plans are not eligible. See att.com/unlimited for current unlimited plans. 
Offer and requirements subject to change at any time and without notice.

Additional Details

Trade-In Devices:
Eligibility: The trade-in device must not be on an existing installment plan must be completed within 30 days from the start of the new smartphone's installment plan. For online orders or when the new device must be shipped, installment plan and 30-day Trade-in window start when the new purchased device is shipped.
Eligible Trade-in Devices: Eligible trade-in devices are subject to change at any time and without notice. For terms and to check if your device is eligible, visit tradein.att.com.
To qualify for max credit (based on purchased device), trade-in device must have min. trade-in value (as defined below) after device condition questions have been answered. 
Eligible Trade-in devices with min. $95+ TiV:
Apple iPhone: 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, 12, 12 mini, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max, 13, 13 mini, 13 Pro, 13 Pro Max, 14, 14 Plus, 14 Pro, 14 Pro Max, 15, 15 Plus, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, 16, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, 16e, 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air, 17e

dialogs.context: Up to $800 via reward card (redemption required). Restrictions apply. See offer details
dialogs.text:
Up to $800 Reward Card Switcher Offer Details

Subject to change at any time and without notice.

Reward Card: Get up to an $800 AT&T Visa Reward card when you switch to AT&T or FirstNet and port-in a new line with eligible postpaid service. Excludes AT&T OneConnect and AT&T Build-A-Plan.
Requirements: (1) previously had active wireless service from a competing wireless provider for a min. of 120 days and in good standing with a min. of 4 smartphone installment payments with an amount owed (payoff and/or early termination fee (ETF)) on a smartphone; (2) purchase of a new smartphone on a qualifying 0% APR 36-mo. installment plan, purchase of a new smartphone bought at full price (“No-Commit”), or bring your own compatible, unlocked smartphone (“BYOD”); and (3) port-in of new line from an eligible third-party carrier (excludes Cricket, AT&T PREPAID, AT&T Resellers, Residential Wireless, Wireline VOIP) on a qualifying postpaid wireless line of svc (voice & data). 
Card amount will be determined by the amount owed on the competing wireless provider smartphone (payoff or ETF) and will not exceed $800 per line; new line must remain active for minimum of 60 days from activation. Activation date starts same day as AT&T Installment Plan or start date of service for BYOD and No-Commit.   BYO device must be a smartphone; tablets, wearables, and hotspots are not included.  Some phone features may not work on AT&T network. Other installment options may be available and vary by account type.
Reward Card Redemption:
Phone number used for card redemption must match the eligible ported number.
Req’s most recent customer bill with current payoff balance (dated within one calendar month of activation with AT&T) or final bill with ETF from eligible third-party mobile carrier must be uploaded via att.com/switcherpayoff within 60 days of activation of new line. Must submit copy of most recent bill for each line ported in.
Card(s) delivered within 8-10 weeks after bill upload to customers who maintain and pay for qualifying service on eligible line(s) from activation date and through reward fulfillment.  Card expires at month-end 6 mos. after issuance. For Cardholder Agreement, go to rewardcenter.att.com. Card is issued by The Bancorp Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. and can be used everywhere Visa debit cards are accepted in the United States, District of Columbia, US Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico.  No cash access. The Bancorp Bank does not endorse or sponsor and is not affiliated in any way with any product or service offered by AT&T.
Limits: One switcher reward card per eligible new line. If new port-in line of service is cancelled within 36 months of activation or becomes ineligible, AT&T may charge back all or part of the value of the AT&T Visa Reward Card. The charge back will be 100% if cancellation within 12 months, 50% if cancellation within 13-24 months, 25% if cancellation within 25-36 months on the final bill and will not be able to reactivate the line of service or have the charge removed. The charge back will occur on next bill cycle if additional lines are active on the account.

BYOD Bill Credit Switcher Offer: Subject to Change. Available to AT&T post-paid wireless customers and verified FirstNet Subscriber Paid Users on FirstNet and Family plan. FirstNet Subscriber Paid User Eligibility: Eligible & verified employees/volunteers of qual. public safety entities or entities that contribute, enable, or support public safety services to first responders and whose duties are directly related to such services. New subscribers must qualify for FirstNet service and complete verification process w/in 30 days. Check elig. at firstnet.com/eligibility. Req. FirstNet-Capable device provisioned with a FirstNet Trio SIM or eSIM card. Limits: Max of 4 lines (1 smartphone, 1 tablet, 1 wearable, 1 connected device) per elig. FirstNet Subscriber Paid User. Account subj. to periodic re-verification. If you are not a valid Subscriber Paid User or exceed the single line limit for each type of device, AT&T may suspend, change or terminate your FirstNet svc. For additional info. see firstnet.com/firstnetandfamily. Requires new qualifying postpaid line of wireless svc (voice & data) on a smartphone bought at full price ("No-Commit") or bring your own compatible, unlocked smartphone ("BYOD") and port-in of new line from an eligible third-party carrier to receive up to $360 off ($10/mo. for 36 months) or up to $180 off ($5/mo. for 36 months). Excludes port-in from wireline or VOIP provider. BYO device must be a smartphone; tablets not included. Some phone features may not work on AT&T network. Req'd Wireless: AT&T Premium 2.0, AT&T Extra 2.0 plan ($360 Bill Credit offer); AT&T Value 2.0 ($180 Bill Credit offer). On unlimited plans, video may be ltd to SD. Speed, usage & other restr's apply. See att.com/unlimited for current unlimited plans. If you cancel service on any other line within 90 days of activating the line under this offer, credits will stop. Activation Fee: $35 Activ. credited w/in 3 bills for online orders only. Bill Credits: Credits start w/in 3 bills. Tax on wireless service, if any, is calculated prior to application of monthly bill credit. To qualify for bill credits, must remain active and in good-standing on new line w/your No-Commit/BYOD for thirty (30) days. To get all credits, No-Commit/BYOD smartphone must keep eligible service for 36 months after credits start. If you cancel service, credits will end. LIMITS: Limit one (1) bill credit offer per eligible ported new line. May not be combined with other offers, discounts, or credits. Other limits & restr's apply. Participation in this offer may make your wireless account ineligible for select other offers (including select bill credit offers) for a 12-month period. Ask rep for details.

GEN. WIRELESS SVC: Subject to Consumer Service Agreement (att.com/consumerserviceagreement) and credit approval. Pricing, promotion, terms, & restr’s subject to change & may be modified or terminated at any time without notice.

dialogs.context: Limited time. $5.56/mo. bill credit for 36 mos. Other terms apply. See offer details
dialogs.text:
$200 Bill Credits: Limited Time Offer. Online Only. Requires activation of a new line of wireless service (voice & data). Discounts: Up to $200 off after 36 monthly bill credits ($5.56/mo. for 36 months). Purchase Requirements: Eligible smartphones must be purchased at full price (“No Commit”), or bring your own compatible, unlocked smartphone (“BYOD”), or purchased on a qualifying 0% APR 36-month installment plan (“New Smartphone”). For New Smartphone, $0 down is available for well-qualified customers; others may require a down payment. Tax on full retail price due at sale. Activation/upgrade fee of $35 applies. Credits: Credits start within 3 bills and are applied in equal amounts over 36 months. For BYOD, tax on wireless service, if any, is calculated after application of monthly bill credit. To get all credits, No-Commit/BYOD/New Smartphone must keep eligible service for 36 months after credits start and New Smartphone must remain on installment agreement.  If wireless service is canceled, promo credits will stop, and the remaining balance on a New Smartphone must be paid. For new lines, must not cancel service on any other line within 90 days or credits may stop. If customer upgrades or pays up/off the installment agreement on New Smartphone early, the credits may stop.  Eligible Plans: The offer requires a postpaid unlimited voice and data plan starting at $60/mo. plus taxes and fees before discounts. AT&T may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy. See att.com/unlimited for current unlimited plans. Value Plus, Value Plus VL, and Value Plus Unlimited plans are not eligible. LIMITS: Limit one (1) bill credit offer per eligible new line.  

Subject to Consumer Service Agreement (att.com/consumerserviceagreement) and credit approval. Returns: Customers may return a new smartphone within 14 days. A restocking fee of up to $55 may apply.  Pricing, promotions, terms, and restrictions may be modified or terminated at any time without notice.
